name: Industry Eyes
description: A major label has been watching your battles. They see potential. The question is: are you ready for what comes next?

chapters.title: The DM
chapters.description: You get a message from someone claiming to work at a major label. They want to meet. Could be real, could be cap.

choices.label: Take the Meeting
choices.description: Can't hurt to hear what they have to say.

choices.label: Do Your Research
choices.description: Check them out before committing to anything.

choices.label: Ignore It
choices.description: Probably a scam. Stay focused on battling.

chapters.title: The Pitch
chapters.description: You meet with the A&R rep. They're legit - works for a major. They see you as a 'brand opportunity.' The offer: $50K advance for a development deal. But there are strings attached.

choices.label: Ask for Better Terms
choices.description: You know your worth. Counter-offer.

choices.label: Take the Deal
choices.description: $50K is $50K. Secure the bag.

choices.label: Need Time to Think
choices.description: This is a big decision. Don't rush it.

chapters.title: The Real Deal
chapters.description: Your research checks out - they're legitimate and have signed real artists. They reach out again, impressed that you did your homework.

choices.label: Take the Meeting (Confident)
choices.description: Now you know what you're dealing with.

choices.label: Stay Independent
choices.description: Labels ain't for you. Build your own thing.

chapters.title: The Counter
chapters.description: You came in strong. Asked for more money, better terms, creative control. They're thinking it over. You hear through the grapevine they're impressed but also considering other artists.

choices.label: Hold Your Position
choices.description: Don't back down. Know your worth.

choices.label: Find Middle Ground
choices.description: Some wins are better than no deal.

choices.label: Walk Away
choices.description: If they can't see your value, that's their loss.

chapters.title: The Strings
chapters.description: You signed. The check cleared. But now they want you in the studio constantly. They want to 'develop your sound.' Your battle schedule is becoming a problem for them.

choices.label: Focus on Music
choices.description: This is the opportunity. Make the most of it.

choices.label: Try to Balance Both
choices.description: You can do both. Right?

choices.label: Battle Rap Comes First
choices.description: Music is cool but this is who you are.

chapters.title: The Pressure
chapters.description: They're getting impatient. Other artists are being considered. The window is closing.

choices.label: Say Yes
choices.description: Don't let this opportunity pass.

choices.label: Pass
choices.description: If it's meant to be, another opportunity will come.

chapters.title: The Final Offer
chapters.description: They came back. Better terms than before. Not everything you asked for, but close. This is their final offer.

choices.label: Accept the Offer
choices.description: You got what you fought for. Time to win.

choices.label: Still Not Enough
choices.description: You know what you're worth. This ain't it.

chapters.title: The Ultimatum
chapters.description: The label isn't happy. They gave you money, you're not delivering. They want you in the studio or they're dropping you - and they want that advance back.

choices.label: Pay Them Back
choices.description: Cut ties cleanly. Keep your integrity.

choices.label: Fulfill the Contract
choices.description: You signed a deal. Honor it.

choices.label: Get a Lawyer
choices.description: Let's see what the contract really says.

endings.title: Negotiation Win
endings.description: You held your ground and won. Better money, better terms, and respect from the industry for knowing your worth. This is how it's done.

endings.title: The Deal
endings.description: You're signed. It's not everything you wanted, but it's a major label deal. New opportunities await - but so do new pressures.

endings.title: The Artist
endings.description: You've transitioned from battler to recording artist. The battle rap scene watches from a distance as you chase a different dream.

endings.title: Burned at Both Ends
endings.description: You tried to do both and did neither well. The label is frustrated, your battle performance has suffered, and you're exhausted. Something has to give.

endings.title: Independent Forever
endings.description: You chose independence. Your own path, your own rules. The money wasn't right, and you refused to compromise who you are.

endings.title: Opportunity Passed
endings.description: You walked away. Maybe you'll regret it, maybe you won't. Either way, you're still doing what you love in battle rap.

endings.title: Bought Your Freedom
endings.description: It cost you, but you're free. No label strings, no obligations. You paid the price for your independence - literally.

endings.title: Contract Bound
endings.description: You're fulfilling your end of the deal, but your heart isn't in it. The battle scene sees less of you while you work off your commitment.

endings.title: Legal Battle
endings.description: Lawyers are involved. It's messy, expensive, and stressful - but your lawyer found some holes in their contract. The outcome is uncertain.

endings.title: What If?
endings.description: You ignored the opportunity. Probably for the best - most of these things are scams anyway. But sometimes you wonder...
